emma: For RBAC evidence, helpful items:
- merged PRs for role/policy changes
- terraform state diffs for aws_iam_role/aws_iam_policy
- CloudTrail query results showing principal actions
Query to use (CloudWatch Logs Insights):
```
fields @timestamp, eventName, userIdentity.principalId, requestParameters
| filter eventSource = 'iam.amazonaws.com' and (eventName = 'CreateRole' or eventName = 'PutRolePolicy' or eventName = 'AttachRolePolicy')
| sort @timestamp desc
| limit 200
```
